title: feat(objectql)!: email template names held per namespace, and ?package= reads an email template exactly (ADR-0150 child B, webhook family 1/3)
body:
Part of #31699

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — measured on head `a52f89e0` and base `48f18b58`: `GET /meta/email_template/NAME?package=X` (and `getMetaItem` with a `packageId`, and `/meta/email_template/NS/NAME`) for a name package X does not hold is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`not-held-by-qualifier`, naming every holder), where base served the first registered package's template. Widened beside it: the package door (`SchemaRegistry.installPackage`), the item seam (`SchemaRegistry.registerItem`) and the cold boot's holder seal (`SchemaRegistry.sealBareNameHolders`) accept, for an email template, a second package holder they refused on base: one that declares a namespace other than the holder's.
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — no published skill teaches the scope of an email template name; `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`'s customization paragraph (a pair's added locale served on the base's address, a dependent's only under its own `?package=`) stays true and is pinned by the #28802 dogfood, which this change keeps green.

**Narrowing: yes** — first-party callers: **0** (measured). The narrowed call is a by-name email template read that names a package X which does not hold the name: it now answers G1's exact qualifier (`409 not-held-by-qualifier`) where base served the first-registered package's template. Callers measured: the send (`template-loader.ts`) reads with no package, so it is not this call; the #28802 / #28830 dogfood reads that name a package (the pair, the dependent, the base) keep their answers on this head (the two that changed on the way are fixed and listed under "Exact qualifier" below); Studio's bundle editor (`StudioBundleItemEditor`) reads an email template at the package the list names it under (its holder, a pair for its base's item, a dependent for its own addition), each of which the qualifier admits; no other in-tree caller names a package. Unchanged and still refused with the same envelope and sentence: a co-owner of one namespace, a package with no namespace, two packages of `base`/`system`/`sys`, a built-in name; the eight `auth.*` templates keep one overriding package per deployment, as on base.

This is the first of three PRs for #31699 (seat ruling Q1 = A): email_template here, then webhook, then connector (`Fixes #31699`). Landing order with #31696 / #31697: whichever is reviewed and green first lands first; the later one merges `origin/main` keeping both sides' entries.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:两个不同命名空间的包现在可以各自带一个同名的邮件模板，安装、冷启动都不再拒绝;`/meta/email_template/名字` 和发送遇到两个持有者返回 409 并列出两者，带 `?package=` 或 `/meta/email_template/命名空间/名字` 时只给该包自己的。同命名空间、无命名空间、`base/system/sys`、内置名，照旧拒绝;认证用的 8 个 `auth.*` 模板仍然全环境只允许一个覆盖包。
- 为什么改:ADR-0150 D9,读取方按(包,名)解析就位后，把「全环境一个持有者」收窄为「每个命名空间一个」;这是 webhook 族的第一部分(邮件模板)。
- 风险与回滚:只放宽;两个持有者时裸名读取和发送返回 409,不会静默取第一个。顺带修了一个读取问题：精确限定读取第一次遇到按语言分片的类型时，依赖包新增的语言和配对包新增的语言被误拒/误替换，现在按该包自己的读。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`(开关集合、`bareNameHoldersMeet`、`isBundleAdditionPair`)、`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`(`bareNameHoldersOtherThan`、`sealBareNameHolders`)、`packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`(8 个 auth 名)、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.test.ts src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`,应全绿，其中 "the narrowing — an email template holds one name per namespace" 一节两个命名空间都装上、同命名空间与无命名空间仍被拒。
- 需要你做的:无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The switch.** `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` gains `'email_template'` (now `agent`, `skill`, `email_template`).
- **Platform-requested names (seat ruling Q2 = A).** Core's `PLATFORM_REQUESTED_BARE_NAMES_BY_TYPE` gains `email_template`: the eight names plugin-auth sends with no package (`auth.password_reset`, `auth.verify_email`, `auth.magic_link`, `auth.invitation`, `auth.account_invitation`, `auth.two_factor_otp`, `auth.email_change_notice`, `auth.existing_account_sign_up`). They resolve environment-wide whatever the caller (D3 Exceptions), and `bareNameHoldersMeet(type, incoming, holder, name)` answers `true` for them, so two namespaces' overrides of one still clash. They are the overridable baseline (ADR-0131 D10), not built-ins: `BUILT_IN_BARE_NAMES` stays empty for the type (census 0), so one app may still override each.
- **Bundle addition (seat ruling Q4 = A).** A package that ships only locales its base does not ship (an addition to the base's template) is still judged against the base whatever the namespaces, so a code package's addition is refused naming the base, as on base (`isBundleAdditionPair`; `declaredBundleMembers` at the door, the registered holding at the item seam and the cold boot). Before the narrowing that held because every holder was judged; now it is stated, so the narrowing does not admit it. Studio-authored additions (stored rows, #28802) never pass this door and are unchanged.
- **Readers.** `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` gains `'email_template'`: `/meta/email_template/NAME` resolves caller-less (two holders → `409` naming both, at every locale), and `?package=` / `/meta/email_template/:ns/:name` is the exact qualifier. The send (`template-loader.ts`) already resolved caller-less (E5); its doc now says why no holder filter is needed after a resolved answer (a package-less row over a two-holder name is not environment-owned, `overlaySlotBinding`).
- **Exact qualifier, first bundled type** (`protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`) — see the section below.
- **Unchanged.** The refusal's envelope, code and sentence; every type outside the set (flow, action, webhook, connector, …); the webhook and connector readers (PRs 2 and 3).

| Position | Before | After | Pin |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Two packages of two namespaces hold one email template name | refused (422 `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`) | **installed**, boots, no warning | registry "two packages of two namespaces each install the name…", "the cold boot of two namespaces' holders…"; dogfood install-local `zeta` |
| A co-owner of the holder's namespace | refused | refused, same sentence | registry "a co-owner of the holder's namespace is still refused…"; dogfood `alphamod` (403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, see below) |
| A package with no namespace (either side) | refused | refused | registry "a package with no namespace is still refused…" |
| Two packages of `base`/`system`/`sys` | refused | refused | registry `it.each(['base','system','sys'])` |
| A built-in name | refused | refused | registry "a built-in name is still refused…" |
| A second namespace's override of `auth.*` | refused | refused, naming the first app | registry "the platform-requested names…"; dogfood `eta` |
| A code package adding a locale to its base's template, another namespace | refused, naming the base | refused, naming the base | registry "a bundle addition of another namespace is still its base's name…" (door, item seam, cold boot) + 2 CONTROLs |
| Two holders, a caller-less send | 409 naming both | 409 naming both | dogfood "a send of the template two namespaces ship is refused with 409…" |

At `install-local` a co-owner reaches the door only by depending on the holder (ADR-0141 D5), so the ADR-0146 D2 override write gate refuses its same-named item first (`403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, nothing installed). The bare-name rule's own co-owner refusal (an artifact co-owner) is pinned in objectql.

## Deviation: the exact qualifier on its first bundled type (G1 surface)

Adding `email_template` to `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` put a type with bundle members (`ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS`: the locale) under G1's exact qualifier for the first time. The #28802 dogfood went red twice on it, and both fixes are in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`:

1. **Admission asks the holders as the caller it names.** A read naming a dependent whose only member of the name is an addition (a locale its base does not ship) was refused `not-held-by-qualifier`: R2 drops an addition from `packageScopedHoldersOf` for other readers, and the layered door's disabled-package probe reads with no member, so no stored row rescued it. `admitExactQualifier` now asks `packageScopedHoldersOf(type, name, X)`, which keeps X's own addition, as the resolver does for a caller.
2. **A pair's member on its base's address is kept, for a bundled type only.** `exactQualifierItem` replaced the pair's added locale (served by `findPairAddedMemberRow`, #28390 ruling A) with the registry's item of the base, whose bare slot a dependent's same locale can hold → `404`. An item of a customization pair of the admitted package is now kept, gated to `ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS[type] !== undefined`.

Does either change the answer for a type already in `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`? Per type:

| Type | Change 1 (holders asked with the caller) | Change 2 (pair keep) | Pinned by |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `app`, `page`, `dashboard`, `report`, `book`, `analytics_cube`, `tool`, `skill`, `agent` | **no** — `packageScopedHoldersOf` returns before it reads the caller when the type has no discriminator | **no** — gated to a bundled type | objectql `package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` "CONTROL — %s (no bundle member): the holders the qualifier asks with itself as caller are the holders it asked before" (9 cases); metadata-protocol `protocol-exact-qualifier.test.ts` "CONTROL — %s: an item stamped with the pair is replaced by the admitted holder's, as before" (9 cases; red when the gate is ablated); the existing G1 narrowing and CONTROL cases of `package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`, `rest/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts` and `runtime/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts`, unchanged and green |
| `email_template` (new here) | **yes** — a dependent's addition is admitted at its own `?package=` | **yes** — the pair's added locale is served on the base's address | objectql "a dependent's added member … naming the dependent is admitted, with or without a member", "the pair's added member is served on its base's address…"; metadata-protocol "email_template: the pair's added member is the base's own…" and "CONTROL — email_template: another installed package's member is still replaced"; dogfood `email-template-dependent-unshipped-locale-read` 13/13 |

## Forced test changes

- `packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.test.ts`: for `email_template` the matrix rival was a package of another namespace, now admitted; it becomes a co-owner of `alpha`'s namespace (`rival(...)`), so each refusal still runs. The two-app override tests move to `auth.password_reset` (a platform-requested name, still one holder). The reason test's second package becomes a co-owner.
- `packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts`: the switch pin reads `[...NARROWED, 'email_template']`.
- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts`: the list pin gains `email_template` as a later child's own.
- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-resolver.test.ts` and `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.test.ts`: `PLATFORM_REQUESTED_BARE_NAMES_BY_TYPE` now carries the email list, and `auth.password_reset` resolves `via: 'unique-holder'` (environment-wide), not `closure`; core's step-2 yield keeps its `closure` pin on a non-requested name.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.dogfood.test.ts`: the cold-boot warning and the delta install refusal no longer name the email template.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/stored-references.integration.test.ts`: A and B also declare one email template name in their own namespaces; the `sealedClashes` pin (only the picklist) now also says the S4 report does not list it.

## Ablations

Each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (mutation landed, restored to the HEAD blob), objectql tests over source:

1. **Switch** (`'email_template'` out of `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES`): 9 red — the switch pin, two-namespace install, item seam, co-owner naming only alpha, cold boot no warning, the 8-name pin, and the two addition CONTROLs. **Over dist** (objectql rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker, then `--absent` after restore): flow-family dogfood 3 red — the boot warning, the delta install refusal, the `zeta` install.
2. **Platform-requested exemption** (the `isPlatformRequestedBareName` line in `bareNameHoldersMeet`): 5 red — the baseline-override CONTROL, the two-app cold boot, the 8-name pin, the second-namespace override refusal (door and item seam), its cold boot.
3. **Bundle addition rule** (`bareNameBundleAdditionMeets` answers false): 3 red — door, item seam, cold boot.
4. **Read list** (`'email_template'` out of `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`): 4 red — the list pin, the caller-less 409 at every member, and both new exact-qualifier addition cases.
5. **Exact qualifier, addition** (`packageScopedHoldersOf(type, name)` without the qualifier): 1 red — "a dependent's added member … naming the dependent is admitted, with or without a member".
7. **Bundled-type gate on the pair keep** (gate widened to every type): 9 red — every `CONTROL — %s: an item stamped with the pair is replaced…` case.
6. **Exact qualifier, pair member** (the `isPairOf` keep removed): 1 red — "the pair's added member is served on its base's address…". Before this fix the #28802 dogfood was 2 red (409 at the dependent's layered read, 404 for the pair's `fr-FR` on the base's address).
